name: velostream
description: VeloStream high-concurrency polyglot live streaming platform

scripts.restart: docker compose down && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @velostream/fastify && npm run typecheck -w @velostream/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @velostream/fastify && npm run lint -w @velostream/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @velostream/fastify && npm run test -w @velostream/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w @velostream/fastify && npm run build -w @velostream/frontend
